taxonomy_note: The original work placed this species in the genus Peribulbitermes; this site now assigns it to the genus Ahmaditermes.
worker: In the worker the apical tooth of the mandible and the first marginal tooth are almost equal in size, the cutting edge between the marginal teeth of the left mandible straight; the second marginal tooth of the right mandible situated towards the first marginal tooth. The surface of the molar plate bears about six grooves.
